cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for Invoice Decision Intelligence - Cognitive S/4HANA Intake. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: Multi-channel intake fragmentation across paper scans, vendor emails, and statutory IRN e-invoices.
70%+ AP clerk time wasted manually cross-referencing PO line items, goods receipts, and quality inspection lots.
Financial leakage from price creep, duplicate submissions, and forfeited GST Input Tax Credits under strict 48-hour SLAs.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Examining the core friction points in current operations. Notice the process bottlenecks that create revenue leakage.
bullets: Disconnected data silos across regional plants and commercial entities.
High variance between physical operations and digital ledger postings.
Heavy developer dependency on proprietary legacy custom code.

cards.title: End-to-End Execution Flow
cards.botDialogue: Notice our 3-step automated flow. From transaction intake to verified settlement, the process is fast and auditable.

steps.title: 1. Multi-Channel Normalization - Standardizes paper scans, emails, and statutory 64-character IRN hashes into canonical records.
steps.desc: 1. Multi-Channel Normalization - Standardizes paper scans, emails, and statutory 64-character IRN hashes into canonical records.

steps.title: 2. Cognitive 3-Way Reconciliation - Verifies PO items, goods receipts, QM lots, and evaluates SAP LIV tolerance keys DQ and PP.

steps.title: 3. SOX-Compliant XAI & SAP Posting - Generates 4-part auditable rationales, routing clean orders to MIRO and discrepancies to MIR7 parking.
